list_repositories            →  repository:list
get_repository               →  repository:get
list_branches                →  branch:list
create_pull_request          →  pull-request:create
list_pull_requests           →  pull-request:list
get_pull_request             →  pull-request:get
merge_pull_request           →  pull-request:merge
create_pull_request_comment  →  pull-request-comment:create
get_commit                   →  commit:get
list_commits                 →  commit:list
get_diff                     →  diff:get
